title: Howie Roseman on Jalen Hurts: If we have issues with any player, we address it directly

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Howie Roseman on Jalen Hurts: If we have issues with any player, we address it directly
sources.description: Most of the questions at Eagles General Manager Howie Roseman's Tuesday press conference were about next week's draft, but one of the ones that veered away from that topic concerned quarterback Jalen Hurts.
